QUICK ANSWERS

Frequently asked questions.

A few things to know before getting started.

How do I get started?

Choose a service under “How can we help you?”, select your business type, and review the suggested documents. You can then contact us for next steps.

What if I'm unsure which registration I need?

Send us a short enquiry describing your business. We can help you understand which service may apply.

Can I download a document checklist?

Yes. Choose your service and business constitution, then select “Download PDF checklist”. The checklist is preliminary and requirements may vary.

How do I submit my documents?

Contact us first to confirm the required documents and a suitable secure method of sharing them. Please avoid sending sensitive identification documents through an unsecured form.

Are these document lists final?

No. They are preparation guides, not guaranteed upload lists. The applicable government portal may request different or additional records depending on your case. We confirm the live portal requirements before filing.
